Off Calendar Feb-10-2005 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: DEFENDANT EARL STAM Motion To Quash Service Of Summons.
APPEARANCES: Milton Katz, Esq. (415) 441-5400 for Plaintiff and Opposing Party; Defendant Earl Stam in propria persona.
Ruling: The parties entered into a stipulation and the terms and conditions were placed on the record as follows: l) Judgment in favor of Plaintiff Johnny Quan and against Defendant Earl Stam for restitution of the rental premises located at 2663-46th Avenue, San Francisco, California. 2) An immediate writ of possession may be issued; However, Judgment is stayed until March 1, 2005. 3) If Defendant vacates the premises by March l, 2005, Plaintiff shall dismiss this action with prejudice, except as to damages to the premises beyond reasonable wear and tear. 4) Plaintiff shall waive all past due rent and attorney's fees and costs. 5) If Defendant fails to vacate the premises by March 1, 2005 Plaintiff, then eviction shall proceed. Prevailing party to prepare order. (302/REQ/JT) REPORTER: BELDON YEE CSR #2647
